body:
Looks good to me. 

I don't think the second `Span` argument (size type) is needed, but if you think it's a better fit due to other types using `int32` more in 3.x, I think it's fine.

The only reservation I have is introducing new programming paradigms into 3.x which will probably not be widely adopted, since it's not as actively developed as 4.x. But on the other hand, having a `Span` at hand there should be safe (since it's copying from the stable 4.x version), and will make backporting some fixes easier. So yea, overall it's fine by me.

Note, I've only superficially checked all the `Span` using changes since I'm not familiar with the code, but I did look at the core classes / containers in more detail.
